name: What should I compare before buying a new bathroom fixture for installation?

mainEntity.name: What should I compare before buying a new bathroom fixture for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should compare compatibility, finish, water efficiency, warranty coverage, and whether the fixture fits your bathroom layout. The cheapest option is not always the best value if it needs extra parts, custom adjustments, or frequent repairs later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare fit, water efficiency, warranty, finish, and whether the new fixture matches your existing plumbing. A good-looking fixture is not a good deal if it needs extra modifications or repairs.
